source: Housing Element 2023-2031, Appendix D (Revised); Municipal Code Title 10; Business Friendly Code Updates (Aug 2025); Mission Boulevard Form-Based Code (Art. 24); Downtown Specific Plan (Art. 28)

notes.combining_B_district: SEC 10-1.2400 establishes the Special Lot Standards Combining District (B). The B suffix with a number (e.g., B4, B6, B8) modifies the base zone's minimum lot size. The number represents thousands of square feet of minimum lot area. E.g., RLB6 = RL zone with 6,000 sq ft minimum lot. The B combining district does NOT change the allowed density range of the base zone - it only adjusts lot dimensions.
notes.GIS_code_pattern: GIS codes like 'RLB6' combine: base zone (RL) + combining district suffix (B) + lot size in thousands of sq ft (6). Similarly 'AB10A' = Agricultural (A) + combining B district + 10 acre minimum.
notes.density_derivation: For combining B districts, density is inherited from the base zone. Lot size modifies subdivision potential but max du/ac remains per the base zone.

CG.description: General Commercial (multi-family above first-floor commercial only)

A.description: Agricultural District. Min lot 43,560 sq ft (1 acre). Single-family + second dwelling + group homes permitted. GP: Rural Estate Density (1 du/ac max)

AB10A.description: Agricultural - Combining B District (10-acre min lot). Essentially no residential density at scale. Maps to Rural Estate GP designation

AB160A.description: Agricultural - Combining B District (160-acre min lot). No meaningful residential density. Likely watershed/open space land

AT-AC.description: Air Terminal - Aviation Commercial. Airport-oriented commercial uses. No residential permitted (aviation operations area)

AT-IP.description: Air Terminal - Industrial Park. Industrial/office uses near airport. No residential permitted

AT-O.description: Air Terminal - Operations. Airport operations subdistrict. No residential permitted

AT-RM.description: Air Terminal - Medium Density Residential. Residential subdistrict within AT area. Density consistent with RM district (medium density)

CB.description: Central Business District. Multi-family residential above first-floor commercial conditionally permitted. Table D-15: consistent with RM and RH density ranges

CBB20.description: Central Business - Combining B District (20,000 sq ft min lot). Same uses as CB with larger lot requirement

CL.description: Limited Access Commercial District (SEC 10-1.1200). Table D-15: min lot 10,000 sq ft, max lot coverage 40%. Residential above first-floor commercial. Recommended for elimination/consolidation into CN or CO

CN.description: Neighborhood Commercial District. Residential units above first-floor commercial uses only. Table D-15: min lot 6,000 sq ft, 17-25 du/ac density range

CN-R.description: Neighborhood Commercial-Residential. Mixed residential and commercial along arterials. Table D-15: min lot 10,000 sq ft, 17-25 du/ac

CO.description: Commercial Office District. Multi-family dwellings and small group homes permitted. Table D-15: min lot 5,000 sq ft, consistent with RM and RH density

CR.description: Regional Commercial District (SEC 10-1.1400). Large-scale retail (min 100,000 sq ft). Multi-family residential subject to streamlined ministerial approval. Only 1 site (~16 acres, Costco). Recommended for rezoning to CG or CN

County.description: Unincorporated Alameda County land (not subject to Hayward zoning). Density per County regulations, not City of Hayward

DT-MS.description: Downtown Main Street (Downtown Specific Plan, Art. 28). Table D-15: max height 85 ft, min lot width 200-400 ft, 40-110 du/ac. Moderate-to-high intensity housing from Main Street Buildings to Lined Buildings

FP.description: Flood Plain District (SEC 10-1.2100). Restricts development in flood-prone areas. No residential density allowed

MB-CC.description: Mission Boulevard - Corridor Center. Table D-12/D-15: 5-6 stories, 35-75 du/ac by right, up to 100 du/ac in TOD Overlays. High-intensity residential

MB-CN.description: Mission Boulevard - Corridor Neighborhood. Table D-12/D-15: 3-5 stories, 17.5-35 du/ac (up to 55 du/ac south of A Street). Moderate-intensity, medium-scale residential

MB-CS.description: Mission Boulevard - Civic Space. Public open space, civic buildings. No residential density. Civic Space Dedication Bonus may add up to 4 units/acre to abutting zones

MB-NN.description: Mission Boulevard - Neighborhood Node. Table D-12/D-15: 4-5 stories, 17-65 du/ac (35 by right, 65 with Major Site Plan Review). Mixed-use infill development

MH.description: Mobile Home Park District. Table D-15: min lot 304,920 sq ft (~7 acres), max lot coverage 40%, 0.7-12 du/ac. GP: Mobile Home Park (12 du/ac max)

NE.description: Neighborhood Edge (Downtown Specific Plan, Art. 28). Table D-11/D-15: max 35 ft height, 40-110 du/ac. Small-to-medium footprint, lower-intensity housing from Houses to Small Multiplex Buildings and Cottage Courts

NG.description: Neighborhood General (Downtown Specific Plan, Art. 28). Table D-11/D-15: max 45 ft height, 40-110 du/ac. Small-to-medium footprint, moderate-intensity from Houses and Rowhouses to Small Multiplex and Courtyard Buildings

PD.description: Planned Development District (SEC 10-1.2500). Density determined by the approved PD plan and underlying GP land use designation. Variable - must check individual PD approval

RHB7.description: High Density Residential - Combining B District (7,500 sq ft min lot). Same density as RH base zone (17-34 du/ac). B suffix modifies minimum lot size only

RL.description: Residential Low Density. Single-family residential. GP: Low Density (max 8.7 du/ac). Same permitted uses as RS but maps to Low Density GP designation

RLB10.description: Residential Low - Combining B District (10,000 sq ft min lot). Same density as RL (max 8.7 du/ac)

RLB20.description: Residential Low - Combining B District (20,000 sq ft min lot). Larger lots suggest Suburban Density GP (max 4.3 du/ac)

RLB4.description: Residential Low - Combining B District (4,000 sq ft min lot). Same density as RL (max 8.7 du/ac). Smaller lots enable higher effective density within the range

RLB40.description: Residential Low - Combining B District (40,000 sq ft / ~1 acre min lot). Maps to Rural Estate Density GP (max 1 du/ac)

RLB6.description: Residential Low - Combining B District (6,000 sq ft min lot). Same density as RL (max 8.7 du/ac)

RLB8.description: Residential Low - Combining B District (8,000 sq ft min lot). Same density as RL (max 8.7 du/ac)

RMB3.5.description: Medium Density Residential - Combining B District (3,500 sq ft min lot). Same density as RM (8.7-17.4 du/ac). Smaller lot allows townhouse-scale development

RMB4.description: Medium Density Residential - Combining B District (4,000 sq ft min lot). Same density as RM (8.7-17.4 du/ac)

RNP.description: Residential Natural Preserve (Residential Natura Preserve). Table D-15: min lot 20,000 sq ft, max height 30 ft, max coverage 30%. Hillside areas where topography determines development. GP: Suburban Density or lower

RO.description: Residential Office District (SEC 10-1.600). Table D-15: min lot 5,000 sq ft, max height 10 ft (reduced for additions), consistent with RM and RH. Mix of residential and office. Recommended for consolidation into CO district

UC.description: Urban Center (Downtown Specific Plan, Art. 28). Table D-11/D-15: max height 124 ft, min lot width 250-450 ft, 40-110 du/ac. Highest intensity downtown district. Medium-to-large footprint from Rowhouses and Multiplex Large Buildings to Stacked Flats and Lined Buildings

UN.description: Urban Neighborhood (Downtown Specific Plan, Art. 28). Table D-11/D-15: max height 70 ft, 40-110 du/ac. Small-to-large footprint, moderate-intensity from Rowhouse and Large Multiplex Buildings to Stacked Flats

UNL.description: Urban Neighborhood - Low (Downtown Specific Plan variant). Table D-15: max height 70 ft, same width as UN, max 34.8 du/ac. Lower density subdistrict within the Downtown plan area, transitional between neighborhood and urban scales
